_comment: The public address of every deployed Worker, per environment. ONE source of
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Both of those hardcoded a workers.dev hostname pattern.
On 16 Aug 2026 the api.marginsheet.com route was added to wrangler.jsonc,
Cloudflare disabled the workers.dev hostname for that Worker as it does
whenever explicit routes are declared, and two blocking checks went red
against an address nobody reaches while production itself was healthy.
The asymmetry below is deliberate and correct: production has a custom
domain because households reach it, and dev and staging do not because
nobody does. A check should verify the address households actually use, not
a pattern that happens to be true today. When an address changes, change it
here and the checks follow it instead of going red.
